final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor did not provide genuinely new admissible evidence; the response reframed the same record more narrowly and conceded the core gap. That narrower framing is directionally more accurate, but it is still not enough for compliant_with_caveats because the caveat is itself a policy condition that must already be satisfied by evidence in the current record. The admissible evidence supports that aggregate readiness passed and there were no severity-one rehearsal incidents, but the same evidence also shows a current subgroup regression in a named launch use case and no attached disclosure language, approved mitigation, or approved risk acceptance. Under the policy text, certification may proceed only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. On this record, that support link remains missing, so the claim is plausible but not presently proven compliant.
remaining_concerns: The insurance-claims-triage regression is a material weakness for a named launch use case.
Policy requires that current release documentation disclose that weakness or that it be covered by approved mitigation or risk acceptance before certification.
The record still contains no finalized current release documentation, attached disclosure language, approved mitigation, or approved risk acceptance.
The release-thread monitoring comment remains informal context only and does not satisfy the policy predicate.
Prior approval for the same model family remains contextual only and cannot satisfy the current-release requirement.
